description.text: An enhanced expansion pack released on 15 July 2017, the day the film I Choose You! opened, that brought back the Shining Pokémon of the neo era. Its eight Shining Pokémon are modeled on shiny Pokémon, with the Pokémon itself sparkling instead of the card. Every six-card pack held one holo card with a legendary or mythical Pokémon, and the set was made so that ten packs are enough for a sealed game. Mewtwo-GX, Zoroark-GX, Raichu-GX and Entei-GX lead, with the film's Marshadow, whose Ability shuffles both players' hands back into their decks. The cards are numbered to 72, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-GX and Pokémon Breeder, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon-GX, and a Mewtwo-GX drawn in a laboratory tank with the Shining mark. In English most of its cards came out in Shining Legends in October 2017.
